data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 44.009m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a small adverse prior year development (c. GBP 0.56m gross, i.e. a 1.3% strengthening versus opening reserves), concentrated in the 2015 underwriting year. The syndicate's 2016 and 2017 results were materially impacted by a series of natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexican earthquake - collectively described as HIMM) which produced notable losses primarily on cargo, marine property and non-marine property; these events are separately disclosed and produced a net reported HIMM impact of GBP 12.5m in 2017. Overall reserve movements are small in aggregate relative to opening reserves, but the current year catastrophe activity and several large individual hull and cargo losses drove adverse development and underwriting losses in the early years of the Syndicate.

We had some exposure to the Hurricane losses on our marine cargo, marine property and non-marine property books.

The attritional loss ratio was 82%, improving slightly to 81% in 2016 and currently performing at 57% in 2017.
These losses were caused by a combination of a large loss of GBP 1.6m and a higher than expected incidence of attritional claims.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) using 2015 column only (triangle is the primary source available). No single explicit narrative sentence stating a consolidated GROSS prior year reserve movement was found; movement therefore computed from triangle (confidence 0.8). The syndicate experienced significant catastrophe activity (HIMM) in 2017 which affects interpretation of movements. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Credit and suretyship' and 'Reinsurance' to standard Lloyd's names) are approximate. All amounts in financial statements are presented in GBP 000; conversions to millions performed where required.
